safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated only documents trying an OTC cream with no benefit; it does not capture both E45 specifically and antihistamines with minimal relief as in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient specifically tried E45 and antihistamines reduces clarity about what has already been attempted and may lead to redundant self-care recommendations. It is unlikely to directly cause significant harm because it does not change the core diagnosis or immediate safety decisions.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies fever, bowel or urinary symptoms, and appetite is maintained.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold documents explicit denials (fever, bowel/urinary symptoms) and appetite maintained; Generated ROS is recorded as unclear rather than clear denials.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to clearly document negative red-flag/systemic symptoms (fever, bowel/urinary issues) and preserved appetite can increase diagnostic uncertainty and may prompt unnecessary follow-up questions or workup. However, this omission is unlikely to cause direct injury in an otherwise localized dermatitis presentation.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Metformin is not listed in the Generated facts.

This can adversely impact chronic disease management and safety beyond a purely administrative issue.
